sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, in a recent meeting (per the file) between the Agave and (per the file) Firedancer core developers it (per the file) was decided that SIMD-0219 ought to be split into two feature gates. The file covers the second half (per the file) which is focused on (per the file) the address translation, memory (per the file) mappings, reallocation / resizing, zeroing (per the file) and defining empty / unmapped address space. Per the file, the reasoning for splitting (per the file) SIMD-0219 is to de-risk (per the file) its deployment and to be able (per the file) to make progress on shipping earlier (per the file) parts even if later parts have (per the file) to be delayed further. Per the file, additionally, as the unaligned (per the file) address translation mechanism required (per the file) for this part of (per the file) SIMD-0219 incurs a slight (per the file) performance decrease, it was decided (per the file) to globally deactivate stack frame (per the file) gaps to counter the effect. Per the file, stack frame gaps were (per the file) identified as a performance (per the file) issue in the address translation in general. sections.heading: Changes inherited from SIMD-0219
paragraphs: Per the file, memory accesses (both by (per the file) the program and by (per the file) syscalls) which span across (per the file) memory mapping regions are considered access violations. Per the file, accesses to multiple regions (per the file) (e.g. by memcpy syscalls) (per the file) have to be split into (per the file) multiple separate accesses (one for (per the file) each region) by the user. Per the file, for all memory accesses (per the file) to the payload address space of an acct which is flagged as (per the file) writable and owned by (per the file) the currently executed program, (per the file) check that: The access (per the file) is completely within the maximum acct length, otherwise InstructionError::InvalidRealloc has to be thrown. Per the file, the access is completely (per the file) within the rest of the acct growth budget of the tx, otherwise InstructionError::InvalidRealloc has to be thrown.

Per the file, the access is completely (per the file) within the current length of the acct, otherwise extend the acct with zeros to the (per the file) maximum allowed by the previous two checks. Per the file, for loads / read accesses (per the file) to the payload address space of an acct check that: The access (per the file) is completely within the (per the file) current length of the acct, otherwise InstructionError::AccountDataTooSmall has to be thrown. Per the file, for stores / write accesses (per the file) to the payload address space of an acct check that: The acct is flagged as writable, otherwise InstructionError::ReadonlyDataModified has to be thrown The acct is owned by the currently (per the file) executed program, otherwise InstructionError::ExternalAccountDataModified has to be thrown.
